pastey

Source: README.md — outside docs/, rendered here for reading.

On this page

A Claude Code plugin that automatically opens the things Claude produces for you to read or reuse in your editor (VS Code by default):

  • Documents — specs, plans and other Markdown Claude writes under docs/, plus README.md, open when written.
  • Snippets — SQL, command lines and similar copy/paste text. The pastey skill has Claude save them as snippets/NNNN-meaningful-name.<ext> in your project, which opens them with syntax highlighting and keeps a numbered history.

How it works

A PostToolUse hook on Write, Edit and MultiEdit runs scripts/pastey_open.py. It checks the written path against allow/deny globs and launches your editor. A newly created file always opens; a file edited later opens only if it has not been opened yet this session. Source code never opens unless you allow it.

Install (development)

Requires uv and an editor CLI on PATH (code for VS Code).

claude --plugin-dir G:\claude\pastey

Configure

Layers, later wins: plugin defaults, then ~/.pastey.toml, then <project>/.pastey.toml. editor and editor_args override; allow and deny lists add to the defaults.

editor = "code"                # any editor CLI on PATH
editor_args = ["-r"]           # reuse the current window
allow = ["reports/**/*.html"]  # HTML is not opened by default
deny = ["docs/drafts/**"]

Defaults: allow docs/**/*.md, docs/superpowers/**, snippets/**, README.md; deny docs/site/**, docs/roadmap.md. Deny wins over allow.

Limitations

  • The editor CLI cannot report open tabs, so a tab you close mid-session stays closed until the next session (or until the file is created again).
  • On Windows, a file whose path contains & | < > ^ % " is not opened (the code.cmd launcher runs through cmd.exe, so such paths are refused and logged). The skill keeps snippet names to a-z, digits and hyphens. A project folder with & in its name never opens files for the same reason.
  • Only text that becomes a file is opened; the skill is how chat text gets there.

Failures are logged to %TEMP%\pastey\pastey.log and never interrupt Claude. Set PASTEY_DEBUG=1 to log each raw hook payload.
